name: frameworks and runtimes
owns: the conventions a language or framework imposes before any application code runs: routing, binding, serialisation, templating, defaults and error handling
why_in_D: Most application vulnerabilities are not written, they are inherited. A framework that auto-binds request fields to model fields creates mass assignment whether or not the developer thought about it. A router that decodes before matching creates path confusion. Nobody in the application wrote that behaviour. It arrived with the dependency, and it decides what is possible.

factors.name: route matching versus path normalisation order
factors.def: whether the framework normalises the path before or after matching, which decides traversal and route confusion
factors.observable: a path reaching a handler it does not textually match

factors.name: trailing slash and dot segment handling
factors.def: whether /admin, /admin/ and /admin/. reach the same handler and the same authorisation check
factors.observable: different responses per variant with the same intent

factors.name: case sensitivity of routes
factors.def: whether paths are matched case-insensitively, which makes a deny rule easy to sidestep
factors.observable: acceptance of a differently cased path that a rule blocks

factors.name: middleware execution order
factors.def: the fixed order in which auth, parsing, validation and handlers run, and what each one sees
factors.observable: a handler running before the check that was supposed to guard it

factors.name: middleware short-circuit behaviour
factors.def: whether a middleware can return without calling next, and what the client receives
factors.observable: a response produced before the guard runs

factors.name: route level opt-out of global middleware
factors.def: whether a route can be mounted outside the protection stack
factors.observable: a route answering without the global check

factors.name: automatic request to model binding
factors.def: whether request fields are written to object properties by name without an allow list
factors.observable: an undeclared field persisted

factors.name: nested and association binding
factors.def: whether nested input can create or modify related records, which widens mass assignment across tables
factors.observable: a related record changed through the parent payload

factors.name: ORM query builder parameterisation completeness
factors.def: whether every clause is parameterised, including order, group and identifier positions
factors.observable: injection through a position the builder treats as an identifier

factors.name: raw query escape hatch reachability
factors.def: whether a raw fragment can be reached from user input, and how much of it is interpolated
factors.observable: a raw clause built from input

factors.name: ORM scope and default filter bypass
factors.def: whether tenant or soft delete scopes apply to every query path including relations and counts
factors.observable: a record outside the scope returned by a less common path

factors.name: soft delete resurrection
factors.def: whether a deleted record can be updated or restored through a path that ignores the flag
factors.observable: a deleted record modified or reappearing

factors.name: lazy loading versus eager loading differences
factors.def: whether authorisation applied to an eager collection is applied to a lazy one
factors.observable: an unfiltered relation loaded on demand

factors.name: template auto-escaping default
factors.def: whether output is escaped by default and which contexts it covers
factors.observable: an unescaped value in a context the engine does not escape

factors.name: template context switching
factors.def: whether the engine tracks HTML, attribute, URL and script contexts separately
factors.observable: correct escaping in one context reused wrongly in another

factors.name: safe string marking
factors.def: whether a value can be marked trusted and whether that marking survives transformation
factors.observable: a trusted value that gains attacker content and stays trusted

factors.name: template engine expression evaluation
factors.def: whether templates can evaluate expressions or call methods, which turns data into code
factors.observable: method invocation from a template value

factors.name: deserialisation allow list
factors.def: whether the deserialiser restricts accepted classes or accepts whatever the payload names
factors.observable: instantiation of a class the caller named

factors.name: deserialisation side effects on construct
factors.def: whether construction or magically invoked methods run before validation
factors.observable: an effect occurring during parse, before any check

factors.name: polymorphic type resolution in input
factors.def: whether input can name its own type, which is the whole gadget precondition
factors.observable: a type chosen by the payload

factors.name: error handler information content
factors.def: how much of the failure is returned: stack, query, path, framework version
factors.observable: stack trace or query text in a production response

factors.name: debug mode reachability in production
factors.def: whether a debug console or verbose mode can be enabled from outside
factors.observable: an interactive console responding in a deployed environment

factors.name: static file serving root confinement
factors.def: whether the static handler confines to its root after decoding and normalising
factors.observable: a file outside the root returned

factors.name: static file precedence over routes
factors.def: whether a static file can shadow a route or vice versa
factors.observable: a real handler replaced by a file

factors.name: default credential and secret generation
factors.def: what the framework generates when a secret is missing, and whether it warns
factors.observable: a predictable or shared secret in a fresh deployment

factors.name: session storage default
factors.def: where sessions live by default, and whether the default is client side and unsigned
factors.observable: session content readable or editable by the client

factors.name: cookie attribute defaults
factors.def: which of Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite the framework sets without being asked
factors.observable: absence of those attributes on a fresh session cookie

factors.name: CORS default policy
factors.def: whether the framework reflects origins, allows credentials, or defaults to permissive
factors.observable: an arbitrary origin accepted with credentials

factors.name: CSRF protection coverage
factors.def: which verbs and content types the built-in protection covers, and which it skips
factors.observable: a state change accepted without a token

factors.name: host header trust
factors.def: whether the framework builds links or routes from the Host header without validation
factors.observable: a generated link pointing at an attacker supplied host

factors.name: trusted proxy configuration
factors.def: which upstream addresses the framework believes for client identity and scheme
factors.observable: a spoofed forwarded header accepted as identity

factors.name: authentication guard default posture
factors.def: whether new routes are protected by default or open by default
factors.observable: a newly added route reachable unauthenticated

factors.name: authorisation granularity per action
factors.def: whether permission is checked per action, per record and per field, or only per route
factors.observable: an action inside a permitted route refused by nothing

factors.name: tenant scoping enforcement point
factors.def: whether tenancy is enforced in the data layer, the request layer or only the UI
factors.observable: a cross tenant read through a path that skips the layer

factors.name: file upload handling pipeline
factors.def: whether type is decided by extension, declared type or content, and when the file becomes reachable
factors.observable: an uploaded file served as executable content

factors.name: uploaded file path computation
factors.def: whether the stored name is derived from user input, which decides traversal and overwrite
factors.observable: a stored file outside the intended directory

factors.name: image processing delegation
factors.def: which native library parses an uploaded image, and whether it is the framework's or the system's
factors.observable: which binary crashes when fed a crafted image

factors.name: URL generation and redirect helpers
factors.def: whether helpers accept absolute targets, which turns a helper into an open redirect
factors.observable: a redirect to an external host from a helper call

factors.name: JSON serialisation of models
factors.def: whether serialisation includes every column or only declared fields
factors.observable: a secret column present in an API response

factors.name: mass read via filter parameters
factors.def: whether filter, sort and search parameters are allow-listed or passed to the store
factors.observable: a query shape not intended by the endpoint

factors.name: background job serialisation
factors.def: whether job arguments are serialised and later trusted, which is a second order input
factors.observable: a job executing with data that bypassed the original check

factors.name: queue visibility and retry semantics
factors.def: whether a retried job re-runs side effects, which turns a transient failure into duplication
factors.observable: two effects from one enqueue

factors.name: scheduled task concurrency
factors.def: whether a cron style task can overlap with itself, which decides race conditions in maintenance logic
factors.observable: two concurrent executions of one task

factors.name: migration execution context
factors.def: whether migrations run with elevated privileges and whether they touch production data destructively
factors.observable: privilege level of the migration process

factors.name: dependency resolution and lockfile integrity
factors.def: whether the resolved version can drift from the locked one, and whether the lock is verified
factors.observable: a version installed that the lock does not name

factors.name: autoload and path resolution
factors.def: whether class or file resolution follows a path that user input can influence
factors.observable: an unintended file included through a resolved name

factors.name: reflection and dynamic dispatch exposure
factors.def: whether a route or parameter can name a method to invoke
factors.observable: a method called that no route declares

factors.name: logging of sensitive values
factors.def: whether request bodies, headers or tokens are logged, which turns logs into a credential store
factors.observable: a token present in a log line

factors.name: log injection
factors.def: whether user input reaches a log without control character escaping
factors.observable: a forged log line from request input

factors.name: health and metrics endpoint exposure
factors.def: whether operational endpoints leak configuration, versions or internal addresses
factors.observable: internal detail returned by a health route

factors.name: admin interface mounting
factors.def: whether an admin UI is mounted by default and at a guessable path
factors.observable: an administrative surface answering in production

factors.name: feature flag and config override from request
factors.def: whether a request can influence configuration through a debug flag or parameter
factors.observable: a behaviour change from a query parameter

factors.name: internationalisation and locale resolution
factors.def: whether the locale comes from a header and is used to build paths or messages
factors.observable: a file path influenced by the locale

factors.name: content negotiation fallback
factors.def: what the framework serves when no representation matches, and whether that fallback is less strict
factors.observable: a representation served without the usual check

factors.name: time zone and clock assumptions
factors.def: whether expiry logic uses local time, which breaks across zones and DST boundaries
factors.observable: a token valid or expired differently across zones

factors.name: numeric identifier type in the store
factors.def: whether identifiers are sequential, which makes enumeration trivial and reference predictable
factors.observable: adjacent identifiers resolving to real records

factors.name: identifier generation source
factors.def: whether identifiers come from a CSPRNG, a counter or a timestamp
factors.observable: predictability of the next identifier

factors.name: password hashing parameters
factors.def: which algorithm, cost and salt handling the framework defaults to
factors.observable: hash parameters visible in a generated record

factors.name: account recovery flow construction
factors.def: whether reset tokens are bound to a user, single use and expiring
factors.observable: a reset token reused or accepted for another account

factors.name: impersonation and support mode
factors.def: whether a privileged user can act as another and whether that is logged and reversible
factors.observable: an action attributed to the wrong principal

factors.name: runtime version disclosure
factors.def: whether the version is exposed in headers, errors or static paths, which selects the exploit
factors.observable: version string in a response

factors.name: framework patch lag
factors.def: the gap between the running version and the current one, which is a measure of inherited exposure
factors.observable: version comparison against the registry
